messages.en: Have you asked the hotel about an extra bed yet?
Yeah, I want to wait for their reply before I book.
Want to come over to my place to watch the boxing match tonight?
Yeah! I'll come over after dinner. Have you checked what time it starts?
That battle was insanely hard. I was so close to losing.
Good thing you got away in time. Let's attack together next time.
Tomorrow's meeting with the client is at our office, right?
Yes, at ten. I've already booked the meeting room.
